an7.50:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho jāṇussoṇī brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an7.50:1.3: bhavamipi no samaṇo gotamo brahmacārī paṭijānātīti.
an7.50:1.4: ”yaṃ hi taṃ brāhmaṇa, sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an7.50:1.5: akhaṇḍaṃ acchiddaṃ asabalaṃ akammāsaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caratīti, mamevetaṃ brāhmaṇa, sammā vadamāno vadeyya”
an7.50:1.6: ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa, akhaṇḍaṃ acchiddaṃ asabalaṃ akammāsaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carāmīti.
an7.50:1.7: kimpana bho gotama, brahmacariyassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampīti. (1)
an7.50:2.1: idha brāhmaṇa, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammā brahmacārī paṭijānamāno na heva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayaṃdvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati,
an7.50:2.2: api ca kho mātugāmassa ucchādanaparimaddananahāpanasambāhanaṃ sādiyati,
an7.50:2.3: so tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti. tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
an7.50:2.4: idampi kho brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyayassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampi.
an7.50:2.5: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa, aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati saṃyutto methunena saṃyogena, na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi. (2)
an7.50:3.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammā brahmacārī paṭijānamāno na heva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayaṃ dvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati, napi mātugāmassa ucchādanaparimaddananahāpanasambāhanaṃ sādiyati.
an7.50:3.2: api ca kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṅkīḷati saṅkelāyati …pe… (3)
an7.50:4.1: napi mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṅkiḷati saṅkelāyati,
an7.50:4.2: api ca kho mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati. …pe… (4)
an7.50:5.1: napi mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati,
an7.50:5.2: api ca kho mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti, tirokuḍḍaṃ vā tiropākāraṃ vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā …pe… (5)
an7.50:6.1: napi mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti, tirokuḍḍaṃ vā tiropākāraṃ vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā,
an7.50:6.2: api ca kho yānissa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni tāni anussarati - (6)
an7.50:7.1: napi yānissa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni tāni anussarati.
an7.50:7.2: api ca kho passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgibhūtaṃ paricāriyamānaṃ. …pe… (7)
an7.50:8.1: napi passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgibhūtaṃ paricāriyamānaṃ.
an7.50:8.2: api ca kho aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti.
an7.50:8.3: so kadassādeti, tannikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
an7.50:8.4: idampi kho brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampi.
an7.50:8.5: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa, aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati, saṃyutto methunena saṃyogena na parimuccati, jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.50:9.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ brāhmaṇa imesaṃ sattannaṃ methunasaṃyogānaṃ aññataraññataraṃ methunasaṃyogaṃ attani appahīnaṃ samanupassiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an7.50:10.1: yato ca kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, imesaṃ sattannaṃ methunasaṃyogānaṃ na aññataraññataraṃ methunasaṃyogaṃ attani appahīnaṃ samanupassiṃ, athāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho, paccaññāsiṃ.
an7.50:10.3: akuppā me cetovimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthidāni punabbhavoti.
an7.50:11.1: evaṃ vutte jāṇussoṇī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.50:11.3: (upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu) ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
